verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs describe a Trust Center product: a branded portal with docs and live controls that automates access approvals and NDAs and is positioned to automate security reviews. Explicit evidence of public certification badges and a click-through NDA flow is missing, and there is no independent corroboration, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit display of certifications, a documented click-through NDA flow for report access, a documented public hosting model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Trust Center puts your docs, live controls, and AI-powered answers in one branded portal, and automates access approvals and NDAs so your team stays out of the loop.
Trust Center helps you automate time-consuming security reviews and gives your prospects the info they need to make a purchase decision.
